layouts.cellular_main_layout: AppLayout wrapper with left sidebar on desktop, sheet on mobile, sticky header with breadcrumbs and scale toggle

accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA & WCAG AA compliant. Navy text (#0F1A33) on Bone background (#F8F6F0) > 10:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing_attributes: EVERY interactive button, input, tab, card, menu item, and status badge MUST include data-testid='...' using kebab-case role naming.
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full support for Tab, Enter, Space, and Esc for modal drawers and sheets.

3d libraries.note: Not required for administrative and mobile church cell governance. Keep interface super fast and responsive.

architecture_rules: 1. ALL frontend data MUST consume real backend endpoints defined in CELLULAR_SCHEMA_BLUEPRINT.md and Mega-Bloque C routes.

2. Mobile Meeting Flow MUST be a dedicated mobile command surface (/celulas/reunion-rapida or /celulas/:id/reunion) optimized for 1-hand touch operation: large tap targets (min h-12), auto-calculated metrics, quick visitor and conversion logging, structured needs logging, and task checklists.

3. Ready-for-cellular (bandeja celular) MUST handle the real operational pipeline: Person ready -> Cellular Inbox -> Select Network/Cell -> Assign Supervisor/Leader -> Register Assignment -> Log First Follow-up -> Activate Historical Membership -> Sync Profile 360/Timeline without duplicating Person.

4. Structured Needs logging MUST implement the 9 Doors contract: persona_id/family, celula_id, type, description, priority, date, reported_by, assigned_to, status, next_action, puerta_sugerida, puerta_asignada.

5. Multiplication MUST NOT be automatic. Implement evaluation, candidacy alert, supervisor review, approve/postpone flow. On approval, preserve mother cell, daughter cell, date, transferred leader and members, and update genealogy tree.
6. Ensure all RBAC scopes are strictly checked based on role (Pastor/Maestro, Coordinador, Supervisor, Líder de Célula, Miembro).
7. All interactive UI components must have clear data-testid attributes for automated verification.
8. Maintain clean separation between desktop analytical dashboards and high-speed mobile execution interfaces.

do_not: Do NOT create generic centered layouts with no visual contrast.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for floating headers or mobile sheets without backdrop blur and bg opacity.
Do NOT use AI emoji slop like 🤖🧠💭💡 for UI icons — always use Lucide React icons.
Do NOT generate persistent demo data that remains in production/QA state.
Do NOT perform automatic cell multiplication without supervisor manual review & approval.
do: Use 2-3x more spacing than default for crisp readability.
Layer cards using subtle borders (#E2D9CC) and soft shadows.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, tabs, and tables carry data-testid attributes.
